criterion: M3 (dated addition, 2026-10-10): RHI version 3 and the hardware G-buffer, the base of M3 criteria 1 and 3
written: 2026-10-10, before the implementation and the first run

scope.formats: RGBA8Unorm, RGBA16Float, RGBA32Float, R32Float and Depth32Float textures, render targets and read-back on D3D12 and WebGPU
scope.pipelines: raster pipelines with up to four colour targets, an optional Depth32Float target with a compare function and write mask, back, front or no culling (counter-clockwise front faces), and read-only storage buffers in the vertex and fragment stages (vertex pulling)
scope.translator: scripts/wgsl_to_hlsl.py gains vertex-output structs with @builtin(position), @location and @interpolate(flat) fields, fragment outputs as a struct of @location targets, and storage bindings in raster passes
scope.gbuffer: a raster G-buffer pass draws a scene's triangles from storage buffers into world position (RGBA32F), normal (RGBA32F), albedo and coverage (RGBA8), triangle id and view distance (RGBA32F) and depth (Depth32F)

format_roundtrip.what: each colour format: a pass writes a committed pattern of values exactly representable in the format; read back
format_roundtrip.bound: bit-equal to the pattern, every texel, every format, on D3D12 WARP and WebGPU SwiftShader

depth_order.what: 64 overlapping, non-intersecting triangles at distinct depths drawn in forward and in reverse order with depth test Less
depth_order.bound: the two images are bit-equal; the control (depth test off) differs

gbuffer_identity.what: the built-in test scene and the M2 models Suzanne and SciFiHelmet at 256 x 256, the hardware G-buffer against the CPU rasterizer (src/renderer/raster.cpp) at the same pixel centres
gbuffer_identity.bound: on pixels both cover with the same triangle: |position difference| <= 1e-3 (1 + |p|), normals dot >= 1 - 1e-5, albedo equal, view distance relative difference <= 1e-4; every pixel covered by one side only, or by different triangles, lies within 0.01 px of an edge of a triangle involved or at a depth tie (relative depth difference <= 1e-4); the counts are reported

gbuffer_control.what: the same comparison with one triangle of the scene moved by 1% of the scene's size on the GPU side

does_not_prove: Frame times; anti-aliasing or sub-pixel coverage (one sample a pixel); that the RTX 4090 rasterizes identically (measured separately under the GPU lock); textured materials (a later slice).
